meta.description: A modular life OS — tasks, money, workouts and habits in one place
meta.manifestDescription: Tasks, money, workouts and habits in one place

landing.headline: A life OS you can extend with modules
landing.intro: Tasks, money, workouts and habits share one data model, so you see them together on one page without switching apps.

plugin.title: Plugin architecture
plugin.detail: Add a module with zero changes to existing code — every page loops over the module registry

recurrence.title: Recurrence engine
recurrence.detail: RRULE + time zones + DST, including month-end dates that don't exist

reminders.title: Reminders that never get lost
reminders.detail: Idempotent, retried, dead-lettered — recovers and keeps firing after Redis goes down

offline.title: Offline-first
offline.detail: Save while offline, sync later with conflict resolution

capture.title: Capture as fast as chatting
capture.detail: Type “meeting tomorrow 10am” or “coffee 65” and press Enter — dates, times and amounts are understood for you

money.title: Know where your money goes
money.detail: Monthly budgets, recurring bills and a month-end forecast, with reminders before bills are due

habits.title: Build habits that stick
habits.detail: Water, running, sleeping on time — count them on one page and watch your streak

oneView.title: Your whole day in one view
oneView.detail: Today's tasks, bills and habits on one page and one calendar — works on your phone, installs as an app, even offline

feed.title: Subscribe to calendar (iCal)

feed.intro: Add this link in Google Calendar (Add calendar → From URL) or Apple Calendar to see NOSION tasks and bills next to your other events · external calendars refresh every few hours
feed.warning: Anyone with this link can read your calendar — if you shared it by accident, create a new one and the old link stops working
feed.alreadyTitle: Apple says "This is a duplicate calendar"?
feed.alreadyBody: You're already subscribed — no need to add it again. The existing calendar picks up new tasks on its own. To update now: in Calendar choose View → Refresh Calendars (⌘R). To refresh more often: right-click the NOSION calendar → Get Info → Auto-refresh → Every 5 minutes.
feed.monthIntro: Download every item in {month} as an .ics file, then open it to import into Apple / Google Calendar. This is a one-time copy.
feed.monthFiltered: Only the modules selected on the calendar page are included
feed.monthNote: Tasks added or changed later won't follow — download again (importing the same file again updates the existing events instead of duplicating them in Apple Calendar), or use Subscribe for live updates.
